purpose: Verified contract for safe reuse of approved property-law knowledge across related citizen questions.
similarity_rule: Semantic similarity does not establish property or legal equivalence.
property_rule: Property-specific conclusions are never copied to another property without fresh property-specific verification.
temporal_rule: Current and historical evidence require matching temporal scope.
legal_rule: Reusable legal propositions require authority, version, commencement and scope checks.
procedure_rule: Procedures and deadlines are revalidated when currentness matters.
citation_rule: A reusable citation does not become property-specific evidence merely by reuse.
limitation_rule: Limitations from the source answer remain attached to reused material.
quality_gate_rule: Reuse never bypasses the current investigation quality gate.
verification_boundary: The engine determines reusable components and fresh checks; it does not transfer unsupported conclusions.
